title: Army R&D golden age and institutions to study ET technology

tellings.quote: the exact time of the golden age of army R&D under Corso. um who said that there were institutions also created to study uh extraterrestrial technology.

plain: From about 1959 to 1969, the US Army is said to have gone through a golden age of research and development, led by a man named Philip J. Corso, and Corso said that institutions were also set up during that time to study extraterrestrial technology. An online commentator who goes by UAPGerb tells this, summing it up without a single source. He mentions Corso and a man named Arthur Trudeau, and points to the Army's own research and development guides. If true, the Army quietly built a home for studying alien hardware.
